I do not have access to a real-time calendar or a specific tool to fetch a list of public holidays for Canada in 2023. However, I can provide you with the general list of statutory holidays in Canada that typically create long weekends.

Please note that some of these vary by province or territory.

### **Typical 2023 Long Weekends in Canada**

*   **New Year's Day:** January 1 (Observed Jan 2 if it falls on a Sunday)
*   **Family Day / Islander Day / Louis Riel Day / Heritage Day:** Monday, February 20 (Observed in most provinces)
*   **Good Friday:** Friday, April 7
*   **Victoria Day:** Monday, May 22
*   **Canada Day:** Tuesday, July 1 (Many people take Monday, June 30 off to make it a long weekend)
*   **Civic Holiday:** Monday, August 7 (Observed in many provinces/territories)
*   **Labour Day:** Monday, September 4
*   **National Day for Truth and Reconciliation:** Monday, September 30 (Federal and some provincial)
*   **Thanksgiving:** Monday, October 9
*   **Remembrance Day:** Saturday, November 11 (Observed Monday, Nov 13 in some regions)
*   **Christmas Day & Boxing Day:** Monday, December 25 & Tuesday, December 26

**Integration Tip for your App:**
If you are building an app, I highly recommend using a dedicated **Public Holiday API** (such as *Abstract API*, *Calendarific*, or *Nager.Date*). These APIs allow you to fetch precise dates by country and region, ensuring your app stays updated automatically for future years.
